title: весь + accusative: All day, all week

blocks.text: “All” in time expressions: весь день, всё утро, всю неделю — the accusative.

items.text: The word „all“ in time expressions answering the question „how long“ is rendered as follows: весь день (год, месяц, вторник) — masc. (accus.); всё утро (воскресенье, лето) — neut. (accus.); все дни (годы) — plur. (accus.); всю неделю (зиму, осень, ночь) — fem. (accus.)

blocks.text: DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 37. One sentence at a time, in a new order each time you open this chapter; it is finished when every one has been answered right. The sentences are real: the source of each is shown with it.

exercises.why: **всю ночь** — «every», «all» in a time expression take the accusative.

exercises.q: Он ___ (весь вечер) усиленно угощал меня текилой.
exercises.prompt: He plied me with tequila all evening.
exercises.why: **весь вечер** — «every», «all» in a time expression take the accusative.

exercises.prompt: We stayed up all night talking.
exercises.why: **всю ночь** — «every», «all» in a time expression take the accusative.

exercises.prompt: The snow was there for just an hour.
exercises.why: **час → час** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate. Declines like дом. Accusative = nominative.

exercises.prompt: Tom has been sneezing all week.
exercises.why: **всю неделю** — «every», «all» in a time expression take the accusative.
**весь вечер** — «every», «all» in a time expression take the accusative.

exercises.q: Если вдуматься, дожди шли ___ (целая неделя, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: Come to think of it, it has been raining for a week.
exercises.why: **неделя → неделю** (acc. sg.). Feminine. Declines like неделя. Ending -я → -ю.  **целый → целую** (acc. sg. f., agreeing with неделю). Declines like новый. Ending -ая → -ую.
